feedback.answered: Initial source tracing connects A1 formation to A2 per-instance ballot authority: handlePropose allocates a local row instance; startPhase1 establishes command attributes and PreAccept state; replies are filtered by ballot and phase before fast commitment or Accept, and matching Accept replies can commit. Recovery creates new instance leadership bookkeeping, gathers a slow quorum of PrepareReply records, and selects command/attributes/status using VBallot. handlePrepare preserves the stored vbal while advancing bal and sends both. However PrepareReply.Marshal and Unmarshal encode/decode Ballot and Status but not VBallot. The actual transport invokes Marshal and allocates New objects before Unmarshal, so no transport-side reconstruction of this field is visible. This is source evidence of a representation discrepancy, not a validated consensus violation. Separately, startRecoveryForInstance overwrites inst.vbal with the attempted ballot before constructing its own reply; this local reply bypasses serialization and can compete with remote replies in highest-VBallot selection. The local and remote issues must be distinguished.
